info.title: Suthrayaa API
info.description:
REST API behind the Suthrayaa storefront and admin console.

**Auth:** send the Supabase session access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Customer routes live under `/api/me`; admin routes under `/api/admin` also check the caller's RBAC permissions on every request.

**Errors** always have the shape `{ error: { message, code, details? } }`.

This document is generated from the running route table, so it always matches the deployed code.
